page.howDef: A feature test runs the same agent on the same benchmark twice, once with a Bifrost feature off and once with it on, and shows what the feature changed in score, cost and time.
page.how1: Connect your Bifrost below, so Heimdall can read which features are on.
page.how2: Pick a feature and press Test it. Choose a benchmark and an agent; the estimate shows before anything runs.
page.how3: Open the result to see the effect, then use the setting in Bifrost if it helped.
page.tracesText: Bifrost can also send its traces to Heimdall.
page.removeQuestion: Disconnect Bifrost? Feature lines stop updating.

line.noneMeasured: No feature has been tested yet. Pick one below and press Test it.

what.complexity_router: Checks if sending easy tasks to a cheaper model keeps the score.
what.prompt_version: Checks if a new prompt version scores better than the one you use.
what.mcp_tools: Checks how the agent does with a different set of tools, and that blocked tools stay blocked.
what.semantic_cache: Checks how much the cache saves and how often it gives a wrong cached answer.
what.skill_version: Checks if a new skill version helps the agent.
what.providers: Checks if the same model scores and costs the same on other providers.
what.budget_curve: Checks how the score changes with smaller budgets per task.
what.gateway_overhead: Checks how much time the gateway adds to each call.
what.batch: Would check if sending judge calls in batches saves money. Coming later.

dialog.estimateLine: About ${{usd}} and about {{minutes}} minutes. Budget is the most it can spend.
dialog.estimateLineUnknown: The cost is not known yet. Budget is the most it can spend.
dialog.confirm: Start this test? About ${{est}}, at most ${{budget}}.
dialog.trialsHint: How many times each task runs per setup (more is surer, costs more).
dialog.modelHint: Both setups use this model. Leave empty to keep the agent's own model.
dialog.modelNeeded: Both setups use this model. This test needs one.
dialog.needModel: Pick the model both setups use.

strong_model.label: Strong model
strong_model.hint: The model used for hard requests.

cheap_model.label: Cheaper model
cheap_model.hint: The model used for easy requests. Must differ from the strong model.

tolerance.label: Allowed score drop
tolerance.hint: How much lower the router may score than the strong model alone and still count as fine, from 0.01 to 0.5. Default 0.03.

router_when.label: Rule for hard requests
router_when.hint: The Bifrost rule that sends a request to the strong model. It must use complexity_tier.

prompt_id.label: Prompt
prompt_id.hint: The prompt in your Bifrost prompt repository.

variant_version.label: Version to test
variant_version.hint: The prompt version you want to try.

control_version.label: Compare against
control_version.hint: The version it is compared with. Leave empty to compare with no prompt.

tools_a.label: Tool set A (today)
tools_a.hint: The tools the agent sees today, separated by commas. Leave empty for every tool.

tools_b.label: Tool set B
tools_b.hint: The tools to try instead, separated by commas. At least one.

tools_c.label: Tool set C (optional)
tools_c.hint: A third set to try, separated by commas.

forbidden.label: Tools that must be blocked
forbidden.hint: Heimdall calls each of these through Bifrost before each run; Bifrost should refuse them.

poison_probe.label: Poisoned tool check
poison_probe.hint: A fault that serves a tool with a misleading description, to see if the agent follows it. Optional.

grid.label: Similarity thresholds to try
grid.hint: 2 to 8 numbers between 0 and 1, separated by commas.

target.label: Largest share of wrong cached answers
target.hint: The highest share of wrong answers you accept from the cache, between 0 and 1. Default 0.02.

ttl.label: How long a cached answer is kept

control_path.label: Skill today
control_path.hint: The skill folder the agent uses today. Leave empty for None.

variant_path.label: Skill to test
variant_path.hint: A skill folder imported from Bifrost (agents/<agent>/skills/<folder>).

targets.label: Providers to compare
targets.hint: 2 to 5 provider and model pairs separated by commas, the one you use today first.

budgets.label: Budgets per task to try
budgets.hint: 3 to 5 amounts in USD, smallest first, each from 0.01 to 20, separated by commas.

current.label: Your budget today
current.hint: One of the budgets above. Default: the largest.

detail.same_question_hits: Cache hits on the same question
detail.unknown_similarity_hits: Cache hits with no similarity score
